basic_profile.bio: I'm a 14-year-old tech enthusiast from California, eagerly exploring the world of virtual reality. I recently got my hands on an Oculus Quest 2 and can't wait to dive into VR gaming. I enjoy learning about new tech and often browse subreddits like askscience and technepal. I usually spend my evenings online after school, and on weekends, I'm often glued to my VR headset. I'm single and love discussing the latest VR games with my online friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in technology, mainly fueled by self-learning and exploring online forums. My understanding of VR is growing as I engage with communities on Reddit and watch tech reviews on YouTube.
